Options :

Mitosis maintains genetic stability by equally distributing the duplicated chromosomes into two daughter nuclei. Before mitosis, DNA replication occurs during the S-shape of interphase. Each chromosome at metaphase is composed of two sister chromatids joined by a centromere. Spindle fibres originate from centrosomes and are crucial for the movement of chromosomes. The process ends with the reformation of the nuclear membrane around each group of chromosomes at each pole and division of cytoplasm.
